name: record_01
evidence: DSS and TNBS colitis experiments used different model-induction and treatment contexts. Combination arms were separate from single-agent arms.

name: record_02
evidence: The TNBS narrative reports that both model and combination groups, each with five animals, had died by day 5. The DSS experiment reports all animals alive at day 9. Exact figure coordinates are not supplied.

name: record_03
evidence: Later weight, cytokine and histology observations, when available only among survivors, are conditional on survival. Death is not a measured normal PD value.
